Liam (docs): Hi all — my PR #4381 is blocked: preview CI failed and the migration guide routing example claims a single precedence order. Runtime says it can vary by deployment. Need a short, accurate wording we can ship.

qa-bot: Deploy preview 4381 - build failed. Error: example test failed (example-routing-snippet.js). Linkcheck also flagged /guides/migration#routing-priority (404). Logs: https://deploy.example/4381/logs

Priya (sdk): Heads up: SDK helpers changed in @redwood/sdk v1.5.0. The old `client.routeRequest(...)` helper showed a simplified flow; newer generate responses include `routingDecision` metadata. Which snippet version are you using?

Liam (docs): I copied the old helper snippet. It currently looks like:

```js
// legacy example
const res = await client.routeRequest({
  model: 'rwd-medium',
  route: 'by_region',
  fallback: ['nearby_pool','standard_pool']
})
// comment: "route takes precedence over fallback"
```

Jas (platform): Runtime behavior: hosted-default tries the explicit route then fallbacks (route -> fallback). BUT if a sticky routing cookie is present and points to an unhealthy target, runtime will skip straight to fallback. Also legacy Dedicated pools might behave differently in some load-shedding modes. So precedence is environment-dependent.

Omar (prod-eng): Also mention `allow_fallback_model_family=true` at the project-level can cause runtime to map to a compatible lower-tier family automatically — another variation to call out.

Priya (sdk): Recommendation: change the example to use `client.generate(...)` and show how to inspect `res.routingDecision` instead of asserting order. Pin the snippet to SDK v1.5.2 so tests are deterministic. Update test filename to example-routing-snippet-v1_5.js to avoid CI collisions.

Liam (docs): OK I'll: 1) replace helper with generate + console.log(res.routingDecision), 2) pin SDK to 1.5.2 in codeblock, 3) add a short paragraph: "Routing decisions may differ across hosted, new Dedicated, and legacy Dedicated pools; inspect response.routingDecision for the final outcome." 4) mention allow_fallback_model_family opt-in.

Jas (platform): Add a 2-line bulleted list with the three common variants: hosted (route -> fallback), new Dedicated (same as hosted), legacy Dedicated pools (may fall back earlier). Keep it brief.

Liam (docs): Will do and push in ~30m. QA-bot, please queue a new preview after I push.

qa-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4382.

Priya (sdk): Ping me after you push so I can sanity-check the snippet.

qa-bot: Deploy preview 4382 - success. Linkcheck fixed.

Priya (sdk): Quick review done. Snippet and wording look good.

Omar (prod-eng): LGTM from prod-eng.

Jas (platform): One nit: change "legacy Dedicated" -> "legacy Dedicated pools". Otherwise approve.

Liam (docs): Fixed nit and merged. Thanks everyone :tada:
